text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was victorious at the Japan 
Cup. But at the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy! It's Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The hero rises here and now! She has 
raised the sword of victory high above her 
head!!

Zenno Rob Roy struck back. Neither of the 
two giants gave an inch this autumn and 
winter.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, conveying "celebration." 
And then...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... does "improvement" start from the 
"Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
From the "ANOI" Arima Kinen. She's 
charting an upward trajectory even higher 
than that race.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy, "we" are chasing after it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Aerial's... ghost... It sounds 
difficult, but I think I sort of 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing the self that existed 
somewhere, and then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I hope to catch up one day! To the ideal 
version of myself that I aspire to be.

At first glance, it looks like the same 
victory. But Zenno Rob Roy has grown much 
stronger.

The two will continue to run from here on 
out. Going to any lengths to surpass the 
"Spook" from the other universe.
